cards-go-fish: Look at your cards. Ask for a number or picture you already hold. Your partner gives you every card of that rank. If they have none, go fish: draw a card. Four of the same rank make a book. The most books wins. Watch the turn story to see what changed. In step pace, tap Let the computer play when you are ready.
cards-crazy-eights: Look at the top card in the middle. Play a card with the same number, the same picture rank, or the chosen suit. An eight is wild: choose the suit for the next player. If nothing matches, draw one. Play that new card if it fits, or finish your turn. Empty your hand to win.
lab-space: This is Earth, seen from above the North Pole. The Sun stays on the left. Tap the coral place dot or Turn Earth to move it one step. Watch the dot travel from darkness into sunlight. Eight steps make one full turn. Can you find sunrise and sunset?
lab-oceans: Build an ocean food chain with picture tiles. Start with sunlight. Then choose the tiny living thing that uses sunlight to make food. Choose who eats it next. Arrows show energy moving from food to eater. Tap a tile to add it, or remove the last link to try again.
lab-animals: This animal needs a suitable home. Look at its picture, then choose a habitat picture. Think about food, water, shelter, and room to grow. A wrong choice gives a clue. Six animals need your help. Tap Listen again whenever you need the directions.
lab-weather: Follow one drop of water. Tap a picture on the water wheel to choose what happens next. Warm water can become invisible vapor. Cooling vapor can make tiny cloud drops. Try a path through rain and the ground, then back to the sea. Only the next possible steps are lit up.
lab-world: Follow a clue around the world. North is up on this map. Tap a numbered map pin or the matching place button. The selected place lights up. Look for Guam, then follow four more clues. The map stretches some shapes so we can see them together.
term-phytoplankton: Phytoplankton. Say: fight oh plank ton. These tiny drifters use sunlight to make food. The leaf and sunshine picture reminds us that energy starts with the Sun.
term-zooplankton: Zooplankton. Say: zoe oh plank ton. These tiny drifting animals eat other living things. Some eat phytoplankton. Small fish can eat them.
term-habitat: Habitat means the place where a living thing gets what it needs: food, water, shelter, and space. A nest is only one small part of a bird’s habitat.
term-water-vapor: Water vapor is water in its invisible gas form. The white cloud you can see is made of tiny liquid drops or ice, not invisible vapor.
instructions-word-imposter: Gather three to eight people. Each person privately reveals a card, then hides it before passing. Everyone knows the same secret word except the Imposter. Follow the named turns and give a clue without saying the word. Then each person votes privately for someone else. Catch the Imposter to win. Tied suspects get one more vote. Every player can be the Imposter next round, even the person who just had that role.
mystery-welcome: Welcome to Picnic Island. Touch a place to walk there. The island waits while you read in practice. Finish the garden, telescope, picnic basket and boat ropes. One islander secretly makes mischief.
mystery-crew: You are crew. Finish four jobs together, or find the trickster at a meeting. A ribbon does not take you out. You can unwrap it and keep helping. Watch who is nearby and check your private notebook.
mystery-mischief: You make mischief. Make three ribbon tricks before the crew finishes its jobs or finds you. You must be close to someone and wait between tricks. At the pump you can turn off the water. Everyone keeps playing.
mystery-garden: Three garden beds need water. Touch each thirsty plant. A tall green plant has enough water. You can water them in any order.
mystery-stars: Turn the telescope pointer left or right until it meets the glowing star. Then touch Align. Find all three stars. Look at the picture; this is not a memory test.
mystery-picnic: Put water, fruit and bread into the basket. Touch each picture. The packed food stays in the basket. Any order works.
mystery-dock: Connect the boat to shore. Choose a rope on the boat, then its matching shore cleat. Match the shape as well as the color. Connect all three ropes.
mystery-pump: The water is off. Go to the blue pump. Open the supply, close the valve, then connect the pipe. The picture shows your progress. During a nearby disconnection the countdown waits.
mystery-meeting: Talk about what you saw. Your notebook holds private observations. When you are ready, vote for one player or skip. A crew member who gets a wrong vote can still help with jobs. Only the parent can start a nearby rematch.
